services.name: Balloons Over Winthrop
services.desc: Join us and experience a true “flight of fancy,” and treasure your memories forever. About For more than 30 years exclusively during the first weekend in March, we have enjoyed flying over the Methow Valley and the old frontier town of Winthrop. We started just flying there for ourselves. But when some of our passengers heard what we were up to, they wanted to be a part of it…so, welcome to our “working vacation,” the Winthrop Weekend. This very exclusive weekend getaway includes the following: Two nights’ stay at the Sun Mountain Lodge, and a balloon ride over the snow-covered Methow Valley.
